names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 10 ianuarie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 6 Ιανουαρίου, «Όσιος Θεοφάνης ο Έγκλειστος», with the rank word left off.

birth.note: doxologia.ro: «Episcopul Teofan s-a numit în lume Gheorghie Vasilievici Govorov și s-a născut pe 10 ianuarie 1815 într-un sat din apropierea Orlovului, unde tatăl său era preot.»

death.note: doxologia.ro: «Pe 6 ianuarie ora 4,30 după amiază, ajutorul său de chilie... a intrat în camera sa. Episcopul zăcea mort pe pat.» — the year given a few lines before is 1891.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 6 Ιανουαρίου — «Όσιος Θεοφάνης ο Έγκλειστος»

attestations.note: The Greek day is his death day, not the 10 January his Romanian row keeps — his life page (https://www.saint.gr/1282/saint.aspx) heads «Ημερομηνία Εορτής: 06/01» and dates his falling asleep «στις 6 Ιανουαρίου του 1894 μ.Χ., σε ηλικία 79 ετών». The folder's existing death year, taken from doxologia.ro, is 1891; the two sources disagree and nothing here is changed.
Not checked: pravoslavno.rs and the Ohrid Prologue for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
